Jack Heart, 2026-11-13, on question 2 (who deletes old remote saves when the worker cannot: a the launcher, b nothing, c a bucket lifecycle rule): "2a is the best of thse options". So the launcher, which holds full credentials, cleans up replaced remote saves. This replaces my suggestion in the previous steer of two alternating remote slots; that was mine and he did not pick it. His earlier words still bound it: extra uploads are not fine and remote extra storage should be avoided, so cleanup should be prompt and what lingers while the launcher is away should be small and stated in the docs. Question 4 (running_hours from the save) remains unanswered by him.
